batch: P6 / T20 – full owner project search, automatic naming and rename

environment.type: jsdom frontend integration harness with real Vue Router and full App; backend ASGI tests with temporary SQLite
environment.network: stubbed; no provider or image service call
environment.data_root: in-memory frontend harness; backend temporary SQLite

scope: the sidebar requests owner-wide title search from the server before pagination, so a matching project on an unloaded page is found without scanning only the local list
empty query, no-result, query switching, clearing and load-more states have explicit UI and request behavior

late list and rename responses are filtered by session/login lifecycle and current query; a load-more page cannot replace or mix another query, and a late account response cannot update the new workspace
the first explicit send already creates a deterministic local title on the server; empty-chat navigation creates no project and search, naming and rename perform zero model calls

explicit rename persists through the real PATCH endpoint and refresh read, shows a safe error on failure, and changes only project metadata, not requirement revision, approval digest, intent, budget or slot state
list status is derived from the current confirmed generation revision; old success is not shown as current completion and unknown remains pending
account security, logout, personal usage and authorization entry points remain present; no balance/recharge, full-text message search, project deletion or model selector is introduced
inputs: real App and Vue Router mounted in jsdom with the existing FetchController HTTP seam
GET /api/projects?q=<owner title>&limit=20 responses including a project that exists only on the server-side page after the local list
delayed old-query result, current-query result, current cursor page, 500 rename failure, 422/CSRF backend cases and an account lifecycle revision during a pending rename
backend temporary SQLite projects and the existing T14 search/rename HTTP suite
commands: cd .worktrees/t106/backend && D:/Desktop/新建文件夹/backend/.venv/Scripts/python.exe -m pytest -q tests/test_v3_p4_t14_project_search.py tests/test_t03_organize.py

commands_output.command: pytest T14 project search/rename and T03 organize naming

calls.note: T20 frontend tests use HTTP doubles only; search and clear issue only GET requests and rename issues exactly one PATCH metadata request. Backend T14 uses temporary SQLite and asserts no model/role call and no revision, approval, intent, budget or slot mutation.

acceptance.FE3-AC-10: pass — the server search finds a project that is absent from the loaded page; rename persists through PATCH and reopen; tests prove only metadata is sent, the old success state is not promoted to current, other-account and late responses are ignored, and no model call occurs.

ticket_items.1_server_search_unloaded_page: pass — current query is sent as q before pagination; test (a) returns a project only for that query and observes limit=20 and q=后页项目.
ticket_items.2_empty_no_result_query_switch_cursor_er: pass — test (a) covers empty query, exact no-result copy and clear; test (b) covers query switch while an old request is pending; existing t02-project-read covers cursor failure retention/retry.
ticket_items.3_late_search_account_lifecycle_sequence: pass — loadProjects captures sessionRevision and query at start, aborts superseded controllers and ignores responses for a changed session/query; test (b) proves old results never replace the current page, test (e) proves a rename response after lifecycle change is ignored.
ticket_items.4_first_send_title_and_empty_navigation: pass — existing backend T03 test asserts the deterministic first-send title 帮我 做一张耳机主图; empty navigation remains client-only and T20 records no create request on search/clear.
ticket_items.5_rename_persistence_and_metadata_only: pass — test (c) PATCHes title and survives drawer reopen; test (d) shows the safe error and keeps the old title; backend T14 asserts no revision, digest, intent, budget, slot or model-call change.
ticket_items.6_current_status: pass — backend T14 list-status test returns success only when the latest generation confirmed_revision equals the project revision, otherwise unknown.
ticket_items.7_preserved_entries: pass — full frontend suite retains account-security, logout, usage and workflow entry tests; T20 adds no balance, recharge, message full-text search, delete or model selector.
ticket_items.8_ui_http_temp_persistence_and_FE3_AC_10: pass — frontend real App/router plus HTTP recorder, backend ASGI plus temporary SQLite T14/T03; account switch, late responses, validation failure and CSRF refusal are covered across the two layers.

probes.results: T20 5 passed; full frontend 208 passed; backend T14/T03 20 passed; typecheck clean

residual_unknowns: jsdom evidence, not a real browser: visual focus order, real viewport and cross-browser search/rename accessibility remain T22/T25 scope.
The test harness uses HTTP doubles; real network latency and proxy behavior are outside this evidence.
CSRF refusal and validation are exercised by the backend T14 HTTP suite, not by a real browser form submission.
The search is intentionally title-only and owner-scoped; message body and cross-owner search are excluded by the parent spec.
No full backend suite was rerun; affected T14/T03 suites and the full frontend suite were run.
acceptance_notes: Completion is based on the focused T20 suite, full frontend suite, typecheck and affected backend T14/T03 suites. Source commit 989e8e7; evidence is committed separately.
